Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. This card’s [Main] effect can be activated when there is no [Mother D-Reaper].
Card Q&A.q: Can I activate this card’s [Main] effect when I don't have a [Mother D-Reaper] in the battle area?

Effect: [Main] You may suspend this Digimon to reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. Place 1 [ADR-02 Searcher] among them under 1 of your [Mother D-Reaper]s as its bottom digivolution card. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
